brief:
Israeli forces killed four children this week in Gaza, Zeteo reported, amid warnings issued to Palestinian minors against flying kites in the territory. The killings occurred as Israel continues military operations in the enclave following the escalation of conflict.

Palestinian communities in Gaza face restrictions on daily activities including children's play, even as armed violence persists across the occupied territory. The warning against kite flying was issued to Palestinian youth at the same time the four children were killed by Israeli forces during the week's operations.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: Israel kills four children as it warns Palestinians against kite flying
